definition.description: Stand with the back to a stable wall. Use available head, upper-back, hip, and heel contacts without forcing unavailable contact, brace lightly, raise both arms overhead without rib flare, hold the declared alignment, step away, and recall the same line. One wall-contact reach-and-recall is one cycle. Wall handstands, wall slides, wall sits, forced contact, loaded reach, assessment, and clinical interventions are separate tasks.
